2707-4377-5498.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

574-1981-2415-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
574-1981-2415-6578.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-6578.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

4289-4770-5301-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1887-2511-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
1887-2511-5254.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

1409-2999-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Impassioned Orator trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

4153-5641-7096.easyPrerequisites: You've had at least one land enter this turn.
4153-5641-7096.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bioengineered Future.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

2757-4573-7824.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two creature tokens due to Bard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Plains
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7782.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Clockwork Hydra.
When Clockwork Hydra dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2646-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Repeat.

618-4456-6747-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying at most {1}{R} due to Sami.
Hematite Talisman triggers, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-4456-6747-7494.notes: If you control more artifacts, the starting cost is reduced by {1} and you'll net infinite red mana.

2645-3918-7434.description:
Activate Trazyn using Brass Infiniscope's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
2645-3918-7434.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you can use Staff of Domination's other abilities via Trazyn.
Each activation of Brass Infiniscope adds a delayed triggered ability that can draw you cards and gain life if you cast a spell with {X} in its cost. If you wish to use these abilities, you'll want to stop the combo before getting too many triggers such that you'll deck yourself and lose the game. To gain life, you must spend at least {2} for X when casting the spell.

4559-5256-7306-7430.notablePrerequisites:
Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
You've had two creatures die under your control this turn.
4559-5256-7306-7430.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gorma.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, Gorma and The Ooze trigger.
Resolve The Ooze's trigger, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve Gorma's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2043-2438-3621.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

628-4050-7197.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2366-2511-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-2511-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

2854-3518-4311-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2854-3518-4311-4574.description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

4522-5346-6847-6891.easyPrerequisites: A permanent you control has a removable quest counter on it.
4522-5346-6847-6891.description:
Activate Duchess by paying {1} and removing a quest counter from a permanent you control, creating a Junk token.
When the Junk enters, Weftstalker Ardent triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Quest for Pure Flame triggers, putting a quest counter on it.
Activate the Junk by tapping and sacrificing it.
Crime Novelist triggers, adding {R} and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Junk's ability, exiling the top card of your library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-4659-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
1456-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1753-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1753-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
1753-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

864-1251-1312-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

465-643-3742-4251-4359.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1322-3372-5231-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
1322-3372-5231-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {R}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

738-1913-4659-6088.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature that is not indestructible.
Transmogrifying Wand has at least one charge counter on it.
738-1913-4659-6088.description:
Activate Transmogrifying Wand by paying {1}, tapping and removing a charge counter from it, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Transmogrifying Wand, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Transmogrifying Wand ability, destroying the targeted creature and causing the opponent to create a 2/4 Ox creature token.
When the creature dies, Glissa triggers, returning Transmogrifying Wand from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Transmogrifying Wand by paying {3}, causing it to enter the battlefield with three charge counters on it.
Repeat.

290-1978-2734.description:
Animate Dreamstone Hedron using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2730-4871-5006.easyPrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
2438-2730-4871-5006.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
When Lurrus of the Dream-Den dies, Kaya's Ghostform and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Kaya's Ghostform trigger, returning Lurrus of the Dream-Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Lurrus of the Dream-Den.
Repeat.

1445-5223-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-5223-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

678-2034-2301-5130.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
678-2034-2301-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Abzan Ascendancy's second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

942-2730-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Samwise the Stouthearted, adding {B}.
When Samwise the Stouthearted dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Samwise the Stouthearted from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Samwise the Stouthearted enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Samwise the Stouthearted.
Repeat.

3836-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

729-1670-5256.notablePrerequisites: Pulsemage Advocate does not have summoning sickness.
729-1670-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Great Oak Guardian, causing target opponent to mill four cards.
Activate Pulsemage Advocate by tapping it and putting three cards from an opponent's graveyard into their owner's hand, returning Great Oak Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures and giving creatures you control +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-2198-2382-4772.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3}, creating two token copies of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
The Deceiver Exarch tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Mimic Vat and any other permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Deceiver Exarch tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2060-3368-4904.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-3368-4904.description:
Cast Biogenic Upgrade by paying {4}{G}{G}, targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Biogenic Upgrade targeting Crystalline Crawler and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Biogenic Upgrade, putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and then doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target other creatures using Biogenic Upgrade.

606-1870-4873.notablePrerequisites: Eternity Vessel has at least 20 charge counters on it.
606-1870-4873.description:
Cast True Polymorph causing Eternity Vessel to become a copy of Darksteel Reactor.
You win the game.

2187-4305-4872.notablePrerequisites: Followed Footsteps attached to Possessed Skaab.
2187-4305-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Followed Footsteps triggers, creating a copy of Possessed Skaab.
Possessed Skaab enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp to your hand.
Repeat.
